MAT009.Consumer.parent_reason_blocks_any:
∀ (parent : MAT009.ReasonSet) (rows : List MAT009.Row) (reason : String),
  parent reason → (MAT009.finalize (MAT009.scan (MAT009.initial parent) rows)).status = MAT009.Status.blocked
MAT009.Consumer.shared_campaign_blocks_a:
∀ (parent : MAT009.ReasonSet) (rows : List MAT009.Row) (campaign : String),
  (∃ row, row ∈ rows ∧ row.role = MAT009.Role.train ∧ row.campaign = campaign) →
    (∃ row, row ∈ rows ∧ row.role = MAT009.Role.holdout ∧ row.campaign = campaign) →
      (MAT009.finalize (MAT009.scan (MAT009.initial parent) rows)).status = MAT009.Status.blocked
MAT009.Diagnostic.register_first_owner:
∀ (registry : MAT009.Diagnostic.Registry) (identity : String) (candidate first : MAT009.Diagnostic.Owner),
  registry identity = some first → MAT009.Diagnostic.register registry identity candidate identity = some first
MAT009.Diagnostic.register_new_owner:
∀ (registry : MAT009.Diagnostic.Registry) (identity : String) (candidate : MAT009.Diagnostic.Owner),
  registry identity = none → MAT009.Diagnostic.register registry identity candidate identity = some candidate
MAT009.Diagnostic.register_other_identit:
∀ (registry : MAT009.Diagnostic.Registry) (identity key : String) (candidate : MAT009.Diagnostic.Owner),
  key ≠ identity → MAT009.Diagnostic.register registry identity candidate key = registry key
MAT009.Diagnostic.register_preserves_exi:
∀ (registry : MAT009.Diagnostic.Registry) (identity key : String) (candidate first : MAT009.Diagnostic.Owner),
  registry key = some first → MAT009.Diagnostic.register registry identity candidate key = some first
MAT009.Diagnostic.scan_first_owner_stick:
∀ (registry : MAT009.Diagnostic.Registry) (updates : List (String × MAT009.Diagnostic.Owner)) (key : String)
  (first : MAT009.Diagnostic.Owner),
  registry key = some first → MAT009.Diagnostic.scan registry updates key = some first
MAT009.M009_R1_initial:
∀ (parent : MAT009.ReasonSet) (role : MAT009.Role) (campaign lab reason : String),
  (MAT009.initial parent).owner campaign = none ∧
    ¬(MAT009.initial parent).campaigns role campaign ∧
      ¬(MAT009.initial parent).labs role lab ∧
        ¬(MAT009.initial parent).crossed ∧ ((MAT009.initial parent).parent reason ↔ parent reason)
MAT009.M009_R2_assignment_overwrite:
∀ (s : MAT009.State) (row : MAT009.Row),
  (MAT009.step s row).owner row.campaign = some row.role ∧
    (∀ (key : String), key ≠ row.campaign → (MAT009.step s row).owner key = s.owner key) ∧
      (∀ (role : MAT009.Role) (key : String),
          (MAT009.step s row).campaigns role key ↔ s.campaigns role key ∨ role = row.role ∧ key = row.campaign) ∧
        ∀ (role : MAT009.Role) (key : String),
          (MAT009.step s row).labs role key ↔ s.labs role key ∨ role = row.role ∧ key = row.lab
MAT009.M009_R3_cross_role_trigger:
∀ (s : MAT009.State) (row : MAT009.Row),
  (MAT009.step s row).crossed ↔ s.crossed ∨ ∃ previous, s.owner row.campaign = some previous ∧ previous ≠ row.role
MAT009.M009_R4_stickiness:
∀ (s : MAT009.State) (row : MAT009.Row) (role : MAT009.Role) (campaign lab reason : String),
  (s.campaigns role campaign → (MAT009.step s row).campaigns role campaign) ∧
    (s.labs role lab → (MAT009.step s row).labs role lab) ∧
      (s.crossed → (MAT009.step s row).crossed) ∧
        (MAT009.familyLeakage s → MAT009.familyLeakage (MAT009.step s row)) ∧
          ((MAT009.step s row).parent reason ↔ s.parent reason)
MAT009.M009_R5_final_set_intersection:
∀ (s : MAT009.State),
  (MAT009.finalize s).childReason MAT009.leakageReason ↔
    (∃ key, s.campaigns MAT009.Role.train key ∧ s.campaigns MAT009.Role.holdout key) ∨
      ∃ key, s.labs MAT009.Role.train key ∧ s.labs MAT009.Role.holdout key
MAT009.M009_R5_parent_union:
∀ (s : MAT009.State),
  (MAT009.finalize s).hasReason MAT009.leakageReason ↔ s.parent MAT009.leakageReason ∨ MAT009.familyLeakage s
MAT009.M009_R6_arbitrary_finite_scan:
∀ (parent : MAT009.ReasonSet) (rows : List MAT009.Row) (role : MAT009.Role) (campaign lab reason : String),
  ((MAT009.scan (MAT009.initial parent) rows).campaigns role campaign ↔
      ∃ row, row ∈ rows ∧ row.role = role ∧ row.campaign = campaign) ∧
    ((MAT009.scan (MAT009.initial parent) rows).labs role lab ↔ ∃ row, row ∈ rows ∧ row.role = role ∧ row.lab = lab) ∧
      ((MAT009.scan (MAT009.initial parent) rows).parent reason ↔ parent reason)
MAT009.M009_R6_cross_trigger_in_finite_s:
∀ (s : MAT009.State) (before after : List MAT009.Row) (row : MAT009.Row),
  (∃ previous, (MAT009.scan s before).owner row.campaign = some previous ∧ previous ≠ row.role) →
    (MAT009.scan s (before ++ row :: after)).crossed
MAT009.M009_R6_final_leakage_iff:
∀ (parent : MAT009.ReasonSet) (rows : List MAT009.Row),
  (MAT009.finalize (MAT009.scan (MAT009.initial parent) rows)).childReason MAT009.leakageReason ↔
    (∃ key,
        (∃ row, row ∈ rows ∧ row.role = MAT009.Role.train ∧ row.campaign = key) ∧
          ∃ row, row ∈ rows ∧ row.role = MAT009.Role.holdout ∧ row.campaign = key) ∨
      ∃ key,
        (∃ row, row ∈ rows ∧ row.role = MAT009.Role.train ∧ row.lab = key) ∧
          ∃ row, row ∈ rows ∧ row.role = MAT009.Role.holdout ∧ row.lab = key
MAT009.M009_R6_latest_owner:
∀ (parent : MAT009.ReasonSet) (rows : List MAT009.Row) (campaign : String),
  (MAT009.scan (MAT009.initial parent) rows).owner campaign = MAT009.lastRole rows campaign
MAT009.M009_R6_parent_reason_survives:
∀ (parent : MAT009.ReasonSet) (rows : List MAT009.Row) (reason : String),
  parent reason → (MAT009.finalize (MAT009.scan (MAT009.initial parent) rows)).hasReason reason
MAT009.M009_R7_nonvacuous:
(∃ rows,
    (MAT009.finalize (MAT009.scan (MAT009.initial MAT009.noParent) rows)).status =
      MAT009.Status.structuralOnlyUnauthenticated) ∧
  ∃ rows, (MAT009.finalize (MAT009.scan (MAT009.initial MAT009.noParent) rows)).status = MAT009.Status.blocked
